BrochureContent.Content:
Russell Estate Agents are delighted to present this three-bedroom detached bungalow situated in the picturesque coastal village of Lower Aghada, East Cork. Enjoying an elevated position with wonderful views across Cork Harbour, the property represents an exciting opportunity for purchasers seeking a home they can modernise and personalise to their own taste. The bungalow offers well-proportioned accommodation all on one level, comprising three bedrooms together with comfortable living accommodation. While the property is in need of modernisation and upgrading throughout, it provides an excellent foundation from which to create a stylish contemporary home. One of the standout features is undoubtedly its coastal setting and sea views. Lower Aghada occupies a beautiful position on the eastern shores of Cork Harbour and is renowned for its attractive waterfront setting and scenic surroundings. The property will particularly appeal to buyers looking for a renovation project with significant potential. With thoughtful refurbishment, there is an opportunity to transform the bungalow into a superb permanent residence, retirement property or coastal retreat while taking full advantage of its harbour outlook. Viewing is highly recommended.

OUTSIDE

The property is complemented by mature, well-established gardens which provide an attractive setting while taking full advantage of the wonderful sea and harbour views associated with its elevated Lower Aghada location. The gardens feature a variety of mature shrubs, hedging and established planting, creating a pleasant sense of privacy and greenery around the property. There are lawned and planted areas together with space to sit outdoors and enjoy the coastal surroundings. A particular highlight is the beautiful outlook across Cork Harbour, providing an ever-changing backdrop of passing boats, surrounding countryside and the water beyond. With some further landscaping and enhancement, the gardens offer excellent potential to create a particularly impressive outdoor space from which to enjoy this superb coastal setting.


LOCATION

Nestled on the shores of picturesque Cork Harbour, Lower Aghada is one of East Cork's most sought-after residential locations, renowned for its breathtaking coastal scenery, peaceful surroundings, and exceptional quality of life. This area offers the perfect balance of tranquil countryside living while remaining conveniently close to a host of amenities and excellent transport links.
The area is celebrated for its spectacular harbour views, scenic woodland walks, and access to a wide range of outdoor pursuits including sailing, tennis, GAA, soccer, rowing, kayaking, fishing, and coastal walks. The nearby Rostellan Woods and the shoreline provide an idyllic setting for nature lovers and those who enjoy an active outdoor lifestyle.
Families are well catered for, with excellent primary and secondary schools nearby, while the neighbouring villages of Whitegate and Aghada offer local shops, cafés, restaurants, sporting clubs, and everyday services. The bustling market town of Midleton, is just a short drive away and provides an extensive range of shopping, supermarkets, schools, restaurants, and leisure facilities.
Cork City is easily accessible in approximately 30 minutes, making Lower Aghada an ideal location for commuters seeking the peace and beauty of coastal living without compromising on convenience.

DIRECTIONS

From Midleton travel the R630 road to Whitegate. Continue ahead for 10 km. As you arrive in Lower Aghada village turn left at Rosies bar and keep left up the hill. The property will be ahead on the right hand side.


VIEWING ARRANGEMENTS

All viewings of this property must be arranged through the selling agents. Our office hours are Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm. We can arrange evening and weekend viewings by prior appointment.
